# Actual producer witnesses

`go-producer-wire.json` is stdout from `main.go`: actual `flow.Aggregator.Add/Flush`
then `flowbatch.New/Encode`, not a hand-authored normalized row. Its SHA-256 is
`52144e8433d6b27191f12615f82d02ed5209a6cc4cf039ad5878735f1000f612`.
The fixture was freshly regenerated offline with Go 1.25.12 and cached
`github.com/google/gopacket` v1.1.19; no NIC/capture/transmitted packets.

To reproduce, copy `main.go` to a disposable module with module name
`c2hunter/sensor/evidencefixture`; require `c2hunter/sensor v0.0.0` and
`github.com/google/gopacket v1.1.19`, and replace both with the current sensor
source and a private cached gopacket checkout. Use private GOROOT/GOCACHE/GOPATH,
`GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTELEMETRY=off`, then
`go run -mod=readonly .`. Compare exact stdout bytes, including final newline.

`test_ai_investigation_producers.py` validates these wires with actual
`FlowRecord` serialization. Its in-memory PCAP bytes pass through `parse_pcap`
and `FlowRecord` for SYN/FIN/RST/ACK, inbound/positive-payload/UDP, truncated
capture, IP_47 and wildcard DNS cases. Metadata comes from `AnalysisParameters`.
Explicitly labeled post-serializer mutations are negative consumer controls,
not claimed valid producer output. INTERNAL is characterized as a retained
legacy compact-row spelling, **not** a real FlowRecord direction.

The five evidence tool JSON fixtures in the sibling `ai_investigation/` directory
are generated by `test_ai_investigation_fixtures.producer_fixtures` from these
actual Go/PCAP/schema producers through repository acquisition and EvidenceService.
